description:
YITAMOTOR floor mats are made with high-density TPE material, using advanced 3D laser technology, which not only provides a superb feel and extreme wear resistance but also offers a precise fit to your vehicle floor.
Fitment
2018-2022 Honda Accord All Model
Only for carpet flooring
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
CUSTOM FIT: These floor mats are compatible with 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 Honda Accord; 3D laser scanning technology gives full protection to both the front and back, Please remove old floor mats before installing new ones.
BUILT FOR DURABILITY: YITAMOTOR floor liners are made from premium TPE material featuring high tensity for great comfort and wear-resistance while remaining flexible and user-friendly even in extreme cold or hot environments; Product contains no latex, cadmium, lead, or any harmful PVC.
ALL SEASON PROTECTION and NON-SLIP: Uniquely designed channels and raised edge can effectively trap liquid, debris, snow, mud, and sand to keep your car and shoes clean; Built-in retainer clips to firmly grip the mat and prevent slipping when wet.
EASY TO CLEAN: Simply shake the dirt out of the textured skid-resistant surface or spray down with a hose; No vacuuming or harsh chemicals needed for maintenance.
WHY CHOOSE YITAMOTOR: Our floor mats are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guard to your vehicle; Our excellent pre- and after-sales services are always available to ensure your purchase is hassle-free.
highlights: They securely attach to your vehicle using the original factory clasps, keeping the floor liners firmly in place and preventing unwanted shifting during daily driving.
The raised edges provide maximum vehicle coverage, Floor Liners accurately and completely line the vehicle carpet giving absolute interior protection.
Specially designed channels ensure the liner effectively contain the liquid to keep your vehicle and shoes clean, non-slip design for safe driving.

specifications.Special features: Solid, easy to install, easy to clean, precision 3d laser measured, perfect fit, waterproof, anti-slip, durable, non-toxic tpe material, all-weather protection
